description: FACT. Use this when you need what changed in Snap's monetization rules since a date: previous value, new value, source, and the date we detected the change. Do not use it for the current rule list (get_monetization_requirements) or for a creator's gap (calculate_gap).

inputSchema.description: FACT tool. Lists approved changes to Snap monetization rules. A change is a record that supersedes an approved earlier record and differs in value, status, or source, or a record with an explicit approved change block (added or retired). Baseline records (no supersedes and no change block) are omitted unless include_baseline is true, and they are never included in changes or in change counts. since and until filter on the change date: effective_date, else changed_before, else the last day of effective_month, else detected_at. They do not filter on verified_at.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

include_baseline.description: When true, also return baseline records in baseline. Baseline records are never included in changes.

program.description: Program identifier. Validated at runtime against programs present in the rules database; unknown values return UNKNOWN_PROGRAM. Examples: unified_monetization_program, snap_star, creator_subscriptions, brand_partnerships, payouts, tax, recommendation_eligibility, creator_monetization_policy, public_profile, lens_creator_rewards.

since.description: Inclusive lower bound on the change date: effective_date, else changed_before, else the last day of effective_month, else detected_at.

until.description: Inclusive upper bound on that same change date. Default: the UTC date of the request.
